answer: Admission needs signatures from three of five signers who rotate every epoch, so a farm that bribes one set finds the next epoch guarded by strangers. Bribing three signers buys one epoch of access at most, and the rotation log makes the bribed set visible before the next epoch even opens. The nadir of the design is public, the prism of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the lotus of honest work is what finally pays.
